title: Economic Crime Supervision Handbook
summary: The aim of the ECS handbook is to give you clear and comprehensive guidance on how to undertake your role within ECS. It will help you understand the legislation, how our policies work and how they should be applied. It will also explain how to apply the sanctions framework and the powers available for you to use under the MLR2017. Additionally, it may be used by external customers to understand how sanctions are applied.

title: Multinational Top-up Tax and Domestic Top-up Tax
summary: This manual covers Multinational Top-up Tax (MTT) and Domestic Top-up Tax (DTT). MTT is the UK's implementation of the Income Inclusion Rule and Undertaxed Profits Rule. These are widely known as the GloBE rules, as set out in the OECD's Pillar Two Model Rules. DTT is the UK's implementation of a Qualifying Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax (QDMTT), which applies the Pillar Two rules to UK entities.
